summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow for Phase 58 (ipns-signature-verify-coverage) end-to-end with --chain flag, producing PLAN.md files backed by research, pattern mapping, and verification.
summary.outcome: Four PLAN.md files across two waves were created, committed, and verified (0 blockers). RESEARCH.md, PATTERNS.md, and VALIDATION.md artifacts were also produced and committed. ROADMAP updated to 0/4 plans complete.

repo: Phase 58 is a backend crypto/security coverage phase (TDD mode, fine granularity, ASVS L1 threat model required per plan) targeting HARD-09 requirement.

The `crates/crypto` crate cannot dev-depend on `api-client` or `core` crates, creating a dependency cycle that forced Rust vector consumer tests into `crates/fuse/tests/` instead of `crates/crypto/tests/`.
The GSD commit helper emits `commit_failed` as a false negative — actual commit success must be verified with `git log`, not the helper's return value.
RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` sections must carry a `(RESOLVED)` marker or the plan-checker flags a warning even when questions are substantively handled in-plan.
workflow: The plan-checker treats a missing `(RESOLVED)` heading marker as a warning even when all questions are answered inline — cheapest fix is a direct edit, not a planner revision cycle.
In --chain (auto) mode with no existing RESEARCH.md, the orchestrator researches automatically without prompting.
Security gate (ASVS L1) fires before planning and requires a <threat_model> block in every PLAN.md; high-severity threats are blockers.
Pattern mapper runs before the planner when PATTERNS.md is absent, classifying files the planner will then reference.

friction: `commit_failed` false negative from the GSD commit helper required a manual `git log` verification step to confirm the commit actually landed.
Plan checker flagged a cosmetic warning (missing `(RESOLVED)` marker on RESEARCH.md heading) that required a separate edit-and-commit cycle after planning was otherwise complete.
open_items: The Rust vector consumer test is placed in `crates/fuse/tests/` as a workaround for the crypto→api-client dev-dependency cycle; the underlying crate dependency structure may warrant revisiting.
Cargo.lock was noted as modified (pre-existing, untouched this session) — the release-please Cargo.lock gap issue from memory remains unresolved.
